gaps.sentence: On the way to Rome we stopped ___ some photos.
gaps.hint: stop in order to do sth
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do; stop doing = finish doing. Here they paused to take photos.

gaps.sentence: Despite ___ three times, he didn't give up.
I want you ___ the truth, whatever it is.
gaps.explanation: want + object + to-infinitive: want you to tell.

gaps.sentence: The rules don't ___ visitors to touch the paintings.
gaps.explanation: allow + object + to-infinitive: allow visitors to touch. (let + bare: let visitors touch.)

gaps.sentence: It's not worth ___ over spilt milk.

gaps.explanation: pretend + to-infinitive; negative: not to hear.

gaps.sentence: She was the first woman ___ the peak in winter.
gaps.explanation: the first/second/last + to-infinitive: the first woman to climb.

gaps.sentence: The scheme aims ___ younger visitors to the museum.
gaps.explanation: aim + to-infinitive: aims to attract (aim at + -ing is also possible in BrE).
